## Event Grid  
  
<!--64f39d77-dca5-479a-b2d8-916d24fe9a61_begin-->

#### Event Grid requires using TLS 1.2 or later  
  
Support for TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1 ends on the retirement date.  
  
**Potential benefits**: Avoid potential disruptions and use new capabilities.

**Impact:** High
  
For more information, see [Azure updates](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=TLS-changes-for-Azure-Event-Grid).  

ResourceType: microsoft.eventgrid/namespaces  
Recommendation ID: 64f39d77-dca5-479a-b2d8-916d24fe9a61
